interface.longDescription: Read-only EU free-movement and EU-family visa guidance with model-led routing for ordinary consultations, evidence-gated source research, legal-source review, and controlled synthetic eudirective tools. EU, Swedish member-state, Türkiye applicant-country, and registered national-source questions retain separate source owners and coverage rules. A portable route receipt schema and local structural gate are included; they check only the model-declared plan and references, cannot discover omitted conditional work, and are not invoked automatically. Host-level release enforcement is not established. Includes the externally maintained EU and national source library mirrored into the plugin package. The bundled corpus is a versioned snapshot; consult official publishers to confirm live currentness. Personal use is intended. Non-personal use for an employer, business, organization, client, customer or other third party, paid services, or deploying the plugin for others requires a license; request one at eudirective@proton.me.
